page.notes: Marginal notes "Cap.7." and "Cap.18." are beside the lines of the text in the left margin; the reference at "Cap.18." was placed beside the line with "attrahentia". Some words in the body are doubtful because of the scan. The text "ut morbum totius substantiæ" and "substantiæ" were read from "fubftantiæ"; the word "tota fua" is clear. The line "Hæc" at the foot is a catchword, not a paragraph; it is also transcribed in main text, which should be checked. Several words near the right edge are cut by the scan.
